purpose: Operator verdicts on Garden STARTER COMPOSITIONS -- which population of plants, fixtures, animals and collectibles the recipient's world opens with. Separate from docs/garden-asset-acceptance.json, which judges how a single thing is DRAWN; a composition can be made entirely of accepted drawings and still be the wrong garden.
why_this_is_not_a_version_number: A world's composition_version is written by the code that generated it. A verdict is given by a person. Holding both in one field made every generated world claim an approval nobody had granted, which is how an empty 0/0/0/0 world characterized as an approved composition. The stamp says which candidate a world came from; this file says what the operator thought of it.
binding: A verdict binds to a composition_version AND the exact roster fingerprint that revision produced. Re-rostering under the same revision number produces a different fingerprint and therefore inherits nothing: approval attaches to what was looked at, not to a number that can be reused.
fingerprint_form: plants=<sorted species@normalized-anchor entries>|fixtures=<sorted catalog@normalized-anchor entries>|animals=<sorted species@normalized-anchor entries>|collectibles=<sorted family@normalized-anchor entries>. Deliberately readable rather than digested, so a rejected world shows a reviewer WHICH identity or authored anchor differs instead of only that something did.

standing: Composition revision 5 remains the historical accepted full-Garden record. The current revision 7 restores its six canonical base fixtures, replaces the fixed off-centre rose with one centered deterministic seed-selected flower from the separately approved pool, and removes renderer-generated planting, ground cover and ambient actors under the operator's 2026-08-11 direction. Revision 7 has no accepted record yet: only a live operator verdict on its concrete fingerprint can add one. The rejected revision-6 1/0/0/0 experiment and its capture sets remain rejected evidence.
